current_prompt: Which Devil Fruit name does the Five Elders say was concealed by the World Government?

corrected_source.arc: Wano Country Arc (Land of Wano Arc Act 3)
corrected_source.title: TV Anime episode listing — ONE PIECE.com

finding: The answer is correct: the Five Elders identify the fruit previously called the Gomu Gomu no Mi as the Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika in anime episode 1071. The official ONE PIECE.com episode listing gives episode 1071 the title ルフィの最高地点 到達！〝ギア5〟, rendered in English as Luffy's Peak - Attained! Gear 5; the episode is in the Wano Country arc. Independent episode coverage explicitly describes the Elders' concealed-name reveal.
